reviewer_independence: Lead agent performed the P3 review after tightening fixture validation to require expected rejection reasons and rerunning the deterministic validator.
summary: P3 passes. Policy checks now fail closed for bad tasks, protected actions, denied candidates, second-control-plane patterns, local-model requirements, and vague work. Bad fixtures must fail for declared expected errors, not merely fail generically.

mechanical_validation.output_summary: Validator compiled and passed after enforcing expected_errors on every bad admission fixture.

criteria_results.criterion: all rejection tests fail for the intended reason
criteria_results.assessment: The validator now requires each bad fixture to produce its declared expected error, so P3 is no longer satisfied by generic bad-fixture failure.
The governance entrypoint and phase gates document the validator command agents must run before claiming gate completion.

criteria_results.criterion: gate ledger can mark P3 PASS with evidence
criteria_results.assessment: P3 has the review and action-report artifacts required for a PASS ledger transition.

anti_drift_results.assessment: Policy failures raise assertions and return nonzero; they are not warnings or dashboard-only notices.
Dashboards remain read-only projections and dashboard-as-authority is a forbidden pattern.
Second control planes, new schedulers, and mutating dashboards are denied patterns with an intended-reason rejection fixture.
Local-model requirements remain denied and are covered by an intended-reason rejection fixture.

runtime_enforcement.assessment: P3 policy checks are enforced in source governance by the validator and fixtures. Runtime admission enforcement is not yet live and is part of later phases.

next_action: Mark P3 PASS, activate P4 private-sandbox-runtime, and prepare runtime approval/evidence work.
